title: Concentrated loads.
officialText:
Floors and other similar surfaces shall be designed to support the uniformly distributed live loads
prescribed in Section 1607.3 or the concentrated load, in pounds (kilonewtons), given in Table 1607.1, whichever produces the
greater load effects. Unless otherwise specified, the indicated concentration shall be assumed to be uniformly distributed over an
area 2.5 feet by 2.5 feet (762 mm × 762 mm) and shall be located so as to produce the maximum load effects in the structural
members.
